items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I did with Louis Armstrong. I was involved with the International Youth Band and Marshall Brown had arranged at Newport for Louis to play a piece and I wrote an arrangement...

ctx.x: Did you ever have occasion to play or be associated with Count Basie or Joe Williams?

No, no I didn’t. I did with Louis Armstrong. I was involved with the International Youth Band and Marshall Brown had arranged at Newport for Louis to play a piece and I wrote an arrangement of “Sunny Side of the Street” I think it was. It was a wonderful thing. I mean the Europeans were pretty good players and all and they played about four measures of the introduction and he came in and the first three notes he just wiped them out, he was so alive, so rich and so ebullient that it seemed like they were kind of…
It’s great how jazz has been spread around the world.
